variants.title: Lissajous ellipse: phase difference made by an RC network
variants.sample: RC phase-shifting network, R = 1 kOhm, C = 2 uF, at 100 Hz
variants.method: Ellipse on the CRO, equal frequencies
variants.note: At equal frequencies the figure is an ellipse. For a series RC network read across the resistor, tan(phi) = 1 / (2 pi f R C) = 0.796, so phi = 38.5 degrees.

source.title: Series RC network: the voltage across R leads the supply by phi with tan(phi) = 1 / (omega R C); R = 1 kOhm, C = 2 uF, f = 100 Hz (standard AC circuit theory)

variants.aim: Feed two signals of the same frequency, one through an RC network, to the plates of an oscilloscope and find the phase difference from the ellipse.
